svg.title: Confirm or cancel a hold and recover a lost reply
svg.desc: Milestone 2 overview. A booking client settles a hold by confirming or cancelling it, and recovers from a lost reply by retrying with the same idempotency key, even after a restart. The Movie Seats API, its routes, the reservation book, database setup, the reservation and reserved-seat state and the schema version change; the Idempotency-Key header and four checks are new. Gray means context, blue means changed and green means new.
svg.text: Confirm or cancel a hold and recover a lost reply
Proposed milestone 2 • Status moves one way, and a client key ties every retry to its first hold.
a hold again by its key.
